Maria G: Quick heads-up — need someone to cover my oncall shift this Saturday 12:00-20:00 PT. Family thing came up, sorry for the short notice. I can swap for Fri 18:00-22:00 PT or take Sunday morning instead. @Aj Patel @Sam K @Dakota

Sam K: I can do a partial handoff, not the full day. Could split Sat 12-16 / 16-20?

Aj Patel: I can take Sat 12-20 PT if that helps — happy to cover the full block. :thumbsup:

Maria G: Awesome, thank you so much Aj. I'll take Fri 18-22 PT then and DM the calendar invite.

Lee W: FYI infra scheduled a maintenance window Sun 03:00-03:30 PT (kernel updates on worker nodes). Expected low impact but batch pool warmup might spike token latencies briefly. See internal note: https://redwood.internal/infra/maintenance/2024-07-??

Dakota: Thanks @Lee W — adding the maintenance window to the oncall notes. Maria, can you paste any outstanding TODOs before you go?

Sam K: Quick handoff snippet:
```
- active pagers: none right now
- recent alerts: transient token refresh errors on dedicated nodes (ticket #3421)
- watch dashboards: /dash/llm/latency, /dash/infra/gpu-oom, /dash/queue/length
- if GPU OOMs: move traffic to small-models routing or scale batch pool down:
  POST /admin/scale?pool=batch&size=small
- escalation: @Lee W -> infra lead, @Dakota -> ops lead
```

Maria G: Adding: last deploy touching routing rolled Wed, no open PRs touching routing. My pinned prompts test set is in the oncall doc. Key creds/links in the doc as usual.

OncallBot: Reminder created — @Aj Patel assigned for Sat 12:00-20:00 PT. To swap use `/rotation-swap` or contact ops.

Aj Patel: Got it. I'll be online and reachable by phone. I'll check dashboards at start, midday, and before handoff.

Maria G: Thank you again everyone. I updated the rotation spreadsheet and left a short checklist in the oncall doc (post-deploy checks, where to re-route).

Sam K: Perfect. Safe travels Maria. :airplane:

Dakota: Noted. @Aj Patel if you want, I can be backup 16:00-20:00 PT just in case.

Aj Patel: Appreciate it — will DM if I need backup.

Maria G: Closing the loop here — swap confirmed. I'll follow up with the calendar invite and the link to the checklist.
